mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_POST(POST_ID, AUTHOR_ID, POST_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, STATUS, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_COMMUNITY_POST.NEXTVAL, #{authorId}, 1, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM COMMUNITY_POST P
AND P.POST_TYPE = 1 AND P.STATUS = 0 AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, NVL(M.NAME, '회원') AS authorName, P.TITLE AS title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(P.CONTENT, 120, 1) AS content, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, NVL(C.commentCount, 0) AS commentCount FROM COMMUNITY_POST P LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON P.AUTHOR_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT POST_ID, COUNT(*) AS commentCount FROM POST_COMMENT WHERE PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NULL AND STATUS = 0 GROUP BY POST_ID ) C ON P.POST_ID = C.POST_ID
AND P.POST_TYPE = 1 AND P.STATUS = 0 AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY P.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.AUTHOR_ID AS authorId, NVL(M.NAME, '회원') AS authorName, P.TITLE AS title, P.CONTENT AS content, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, TO_CHAR(P.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM COMMUNITY_POST P LEFT OUTER JOIN MEMBER M ON P.AUTHOR_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId} AND P.POST_TYPE = 1 AND P.STATUS = 0 AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY_POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND AUTHOR_ID = #{authorId} AND POST_TYPE = 1 AND STATUS = 0 AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

UPDATE COMMUNITY_POST SET STATUS = 2, DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND AUTHOR_ID = #{authorId} AND POST_TYPE = 1 AND STATUS = 0 AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title FROM COMMUNITY_POST P
AND P.POST_ID > #{postId} AND P.POST_TYPE = 1 AND P.STATUS = 0 AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY P.POST_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title FROM COMMUNITY_POST P
AND P.POST_ID < #{postId} AND P.POST_TYPE = 1 AND P.STATUS = 0 AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY P.POST_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
